task_description: Add Sentry source maps for production debugging - Enable automatic source map uploads to Sentry during production builds to make error stack traces readable

patterns.vite_plugin_pattern: Vite uses plugins array with react() and tailwindcss(). New plugins should follow same import/configuration pattern.
patterns.environment_variable_pattern: Uses import.meta.env.VITE_* for client-side vars. Build-time vars use process.env directly.
patterns.sentry_configuration: Sentry SDK already configured with DSN, ErrorBoundary, and Session Replay in src/lib/sentry.ts
patterns.conditional_plugins: Should use process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' check with .filter(Boolean) to remove false values

existing_implementations.description: Sentry runtime SDK (@sentry/react v10.32.1) already installed and configured. Missing only build-time source map upload capability.
